golemaddons.animations.no_equip_reset.to: Switching items doesn't lower and raise your hand: the new item is just there.
golemaddons.hub.terminals.desc: Floor 7 terminal solvers with a compact GUI and hover click.
golemaddons.terminals.title: Terminals
golemaddons.terminals.preview.hint: Click the highlighted tiles to try it
golemaddons.terminals.enabled.tooltip: Show the answer in every Floor 7 terminal (recognised by the chest title).
golemaddons.terminals.custom_gui.tooltip: Replace the chest with a clean grid of just the puzzle. Off: highlight the answer on the normal chest.
golemaddons.terminals.block_wrong.toolti: Clicks that aren't part of the answer are never sent. In Click in Order only the next number counts.
golemaddons.terminals.hover_click.toolti: Clicks a correct tile as soon as your cursor rests on it. Just sweep the cursor over the highlights.
golemaddons.terminals.hover_delay.toolti: How long the cursor rests on a tile before hover click fires.
golemaddons.terminals.click_delay.toolti: Hover click never clicks faster than this.
golemaddons.terminals.first_delay.toolti: No hover clicks this soon after a terminal opens. Servers ignore clicks made the moment it opens.
golemaddons.terminals.practice_ping.tool: How long /gatestterms waits before answering a click, like a server would.
golemaddons.terminals.practice.tooltip: Saves, then opens every terminal type in a random order, run on your own game (/gatestterms). Nothing is sent to the server.
golemaddons.terminals.scale.tooltip: Size of the compact GUI's tiles. It shrinks on its own if the window is too small.
golemaddons.terminals.status.wait_align: Wait for it to line up…
golemaddons.terminals.practice.unknown: Unknown terminal "%s". Use all, order, panes, starts_with, colors, rubix or melody.
golemaddons.terminals.practice.all: All terminals done: %s solving (%s with gaps), %s wrong clicks.
golemaddons.terminals.practice.overlay: Practice %s/%s · %s · ping %s ms · Esc to stop
golemaddons.terminals.fade.tooltip: In Starts With and Select All, dim every item that isn't an answer so the right ones stand out. Set how much with Darken and Saturation.
golemaddons.terminals.fade_amount.toolti: How dark the wrong items get. 0% keeps their brightness.
golemaddons.terminals.auto.tooltip: Solves terminals by itself, no mouse needed: one correct click every Click delay, after the First click delay. Servers may treat this as cheating. Use at your own risk.
How much colour the wrong items keep. 0% is grey, 100% unchanged.
golemaddons.updates.unavailable.not_writ: The folder the mod jar is in can't be written to, so install it from the release page.
golemaddons.hub.combat.desc: Riftborn Seraph helpers and Bone swap.
golemaddons.hub.afk.desc: Tracks /afk dragons and gets you back to /afk after a disconnect or warp.
golemaddons.hub.boneswap.desc: One key throws every Bonemerang in your hotbar.
golemaddons.hud.help: Drag to move · scroll or +/- to resize (%s) · R resets
golemaddons.afk.title: AFK Helper
golemaddons.afk.enabled.tooltip: Running /afk starts a session: the dragon tracker HUD, and getting you back to /afk if something interrupts it.
golemaddons.afk.reconnect.tooltip: If the connection drops during a session, join the same server again and run /afk.
golemaddons.afk.reopen.tooltip: If the AFK menu closes without you closing it (a warp, a lobby switch, a restart), run /afk again.
golemaddons.afk.show_hud.tooltip: Show which dragons this session has given you.
golemaddons.afk.hud_always: Show the HUD with no session
golemaddons.afk.hud_always.tooltip: Keep the tracker on screen even when no /afk session is running.
golemaddons.afk.reconnect_delay.tooltip: Wait before the first reconnect. Each failed try waits twice as long, up to five minutes.
golemaddons.afk.reopen_delay.tooltip: Wait before running /afk again after the menu closed or after joining.
golemaddons.afk.hub.tooltip: Run before /afk when /afk doesn't open the menu (for when you got sent somewhere /afk doesn't work). Blank: never.
golemaddons.afk.edit_hud.tooltip: Drag the tracker where you want it and scroll to change its size.
golemaddons.afk.test_tools.tooltip: The buttons below and /gaafk test disconnect | lobby | reward. Turn this off once you trust the helper.
golemaddons.afk.test.disconnect.tooltip: Cuts your connection like a Wi-Fi drop, so you can watch the helper reconnect.
golemaddons.afk.test.lobby.tooltip: Closes the AFK menu like a warp and runs the hub command, so you can watch the helper reopen /afk.
golemaddons.afk.test.reward.tooltip: Adds a random dragon to the tracker, to see the HUD.
golemaddons.afk.test.disabled: Test tools are off (AFK Helper → Session & testing).
golemaddons.afk.test.disconnect_reason: Connection dropped by GolemAddons (AFK helper test)
golemaddons.afk.started: AFK helper on: it reconnects and runs /afk again if you get disconnected or moved. Close the AFK menu yourself to stop it.
golemaddons.afk.started.local: AFK helper on (singleplayer: it can reopen /afk but not reconnect).
golemaddons.afk.stopped.closed: AFK helper stopped: you closed the AFK menu. %s dragons this session.
golemaddons.afk.stopped.command: AFK helper stopped. %s dragons this session.
golemaddons.afk.stopped.left: AFK helper stopped. %s dragons this session.
golemaddons.riftborn.title: Riftborn Seraph
golemaddons.riftborn.anchors.tooltip: After "It hangs itself on N anchors", outline every sea lantern nearby until it breaks.
golemaddons.riftborn.through_walls.toolt: Draw the outlines on top of everything.
golemaddons.riftborn.radius.tooltip: How far around you to look for the anchors.
golemaddons.riftborn.auto_attunement.too: While you aim at a marked half, hold its dagger and switch it to the mark: Fleshrend for FLESH or ICHOR, Voidfang for VOID or AETHER.
golemaddons.riftborn.switch_dagger.toolt: Also change your held item to the dagger the target needs. Off: only switch attunement on the dagger you hold.
golemaddons.riftborn.margin.tooltip: Added to the 0.3 s attunement cooldown, for ping.
golemaddons.riftborn.hint: Active during the fight only. /gaseraph shows what it reads.
golemaddons.riftborn.attunement.unreadab: Auto attunement can't tell which attunement your dagger is in. Hold it and run /gaseraph item, then send that to the developer.
golemaddons.boneswap.title: Bone Swap
golemaddons.boneswap.key.tooltip: Press it to throw every Bonemerang in your hotbar, left to right. Click, then press a key; Escape clears it.
golemaddons.boneswap.item.tooltip: Hotbar items whose name contains this are thrown.
golemaddons.boneswap.end.tooltip: The slot selected once every bone is thrown.
golemaddons.boneswap.variation.tooltip: Each delay is randomly changed by up to this much either way.
golemaddons.boneswap.hint: Selects each Bonemerang slot, right-clicks it, then goes to the end slot.
